### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **13** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **8** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/declaration-map/ui.json`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**15** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx`  _(via service_agent (literal, a string literal in AppLandingEntrySchema; a string literal in a comment in AppSchema))_
- `content/docs/automation/queues-and-assignment-rules.mdx`  _(via service_agent (literal, a string literal in AppLandingEntrySchema; a string literal in a comment in AppSchema))_

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-0.mdx`  _(via AppSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **8** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/declaration-map/ui.json`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- the SDK route bridge reached **60** of **212** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **168** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json bede9deaed99f86111194c8955edd7fb3ad15fc2` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `813f5914466eb6468fb78515ff8655752ef95925` — the merge of head `010f9645a73044bc655376a5e193a6e62f5303c2` into base `bede9deaed99f86111194c8955edd7fb3ad15fc2`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 813f5914466eb6468fb78515ff8655752ef95925 && git checkout 813f5914466eb6468fb78515ff8655752ef95925
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin bede9deaed99f86111194c8955edd7fb3ad15fc2 010f9645a73044bc655376a5e193a6e62f5303c2 && git checkout -B drift-repro bede9deaed99f86111194c8955edd7fb3ad15fc2 && git merge --no-ff 010f9645a73044bc655376a5e193a6e62f5303c2

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json bede9deaed99f86111194c8955edd7fb3ad15fc2
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs bede9deaed99f86111194c8955edd7fb3ad15fc2` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Scope: packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts (`AppLandingEntrySchema` strict `{ item, visible }` with spellings; `checkAppLandingItems` exported and mounted as `AppSchema`'s `superRefine`; `landing: z.array(…).min(1).optional()` with `landings` / `landingpages` spellings; the `homePageId` tombstone text and docblock), packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts (landing predicates through the shared validator, no object, no `record` scope), the new app-landing.test.ts (14), lint tests, liveness `app.landing` row (`planned`, `authorWarn`, children `item` / `visible`), evaluated-slot census 32 → 33, dogfood `cel-app-landing` row, form-reconciliation `omit` row, `/meta/types` app count 22 → 23, dropped-refinements ledger (+1 site in six entries, header total 942 → 948), objectui census `notAttachable: ['checkAppLandingItems']` (test-only line, claim amendment 6545506798), `content/docs/ui/apps.mdx` + regenerated references, changeset (`@objectstack/spec` + `@objectstack/lint` minor). 23 files, +595/−31. Fixes #28022 (ruling A 6545223246; claim 6545300407 + amendment; follow-up ui card #28450 open, `pm:blocked`). Not governed.
Inputs: card #28022 thread (ruling, claim, amendment), the PR body, the PR diff at the held head 1308512c (spec, lint, liveness, ledger, census and changeset hunks read in full; tests by case) plus the one-commit delta to this head (`dropped-refinements.baseline.json` header `droppedRefinementSites` 942 → 948, the fix for the red Test Core 2/8 leg named in the hold note 6546648889), `git grep` on `origin/main` (`celReadsRootData` L1017, `authoredVisibleEnvelope` L1046, `navItemVisibleDataNeedsDataSource` L1097 reused; a navigation entry's `visible` is the same `EvaluatedExpressionInputSchema`; `AppSchema` had no object-level `superRefine` before, so the ledger's new `""` site under `ui/App` and the six `…apps.element` sites are the one new drop), check-runs (read 2026-10-31T17:58Z: all 65 latest-per-name check-runs completed, 58 success + 7 skipped, none failed, none running) — 65 checks. Nothing built or run here; the seat's numbers (108 derived gates, 14/14, two ablations) are the PR body's.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Letter A as ruled.** A new app-level key, a list of `{ item, visible }` entries, first match wins, no match or no key keeps today's rule (first navigation item by `order`). The ruling named the ripple — liveness row, lint of the predicate, docs — and the diff carries each, plus the gate-forced ledgers. B (reuse `navigationContributions`) was not taken and is not smuggled in: a contributed item cannot even be named.
- **The tombstone's two objections are answered in the shape, not in prose only.** `item` is an id into the app's own navigation, but `checkAppLandingItems` runs on every app parse, so a dangling id or a `group` / `separator` / `action` target is refused at `landing.N.item` with the openable ids listed, instead of resolving to the first item silently. `visible` is required and an empty list is refused, so there is no "everyone lands here" under a new name. The `data` read refusal reuses the navigation entry's lexer at `landing.N.visible`.
- **Mounting is the only object-level refinement on `AppSchema`**, so the dropped-refinements ledger gains exactly one site per place `AppSchema` is embedded in a published shape (six entries, including the bare `""` under `ui/App`), and the header total moves by six — the delta commit. The isomorphism, census, `/meta/types` count and form-reconciliation rows move by the one new key each.
- **Lint half is scoped right.** Landing predicates get the data-independent verdicts (syntax, size, unknown function, `has()` shape) with no object and no `record` scope, because the slot binds no record; `objectWrite` reads an empty list because apps are not an object body. The PR states what is not judged (the save door does not run the lint half; no root verdict on `record.x`) and leaves both to the console card — honest and acceptable.
- **Planned, declared loudly.** Liveness `planned` + `authorWarn` + hint, `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]` first in the describe text, a Planned callout in the docs, the dogfood row `experimental` / `unevaluated`. An author who writes `landing` today is told nothing reads it. The flip to `live` is #28450's, named in the row's note.
- **Declarations.** `Clause-②: yes (widening)` — a new authorable key; `Metadata-protocol: added`; spec + lint minor. The ui census line is test-only and inside the amended claim; no `ui/**` source edit. `Fixes #28022` is right: the spec half is the card; the redirect is #28450.

### ② Rulings cited

- 6545223246 (spec seat 2 recording the maintainer's 「同意」 on the 2026-10-31 list item 3, 2026-10-31T15:10Z): letter **A**. Implemented as ruled; no open ruling.

### ③ Narrowing / widening

- Widening only: `app.landing` becomes authorable. Existing apps parse as before (control case pinned). New refusals apply to the new key alone.

### ④ Behaviour / flags

- Seat lands (Tier S path) after this record; `needs:contract-review` pulled by the lane.
- #28450 (domain:ui, `pm:blocked`) owes: the console redirect reading `landing`, attaching `checkAppLandingItems` to objectui's `AppComponentSchema` (dropping the `notAttachable` line), the liveness flip, and the conformance row re-class.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 应用（`AppSchema`）新增可选键 `landing`：一组 `{ item, visible }`，按顺序取第一个 `visible` 条件成立的导航项作为落地页；都不成立时沿用现规则，即第一个导航项。指向不存在的导航项、分组/分隔线/动作项，或在条件里读数据，都会在解析时直接拒绝，不会像旧的 `homePageId` 那样悄悄退回第一项。
- **为什么改：** 你裁定 #28022 选 A。同一个应用给不同受众用时（如 HotCRM 的销售与服务），每类人要能落在自己的首页。
- **风险与回滚：** 只加一个可选键，不写它的应用解析和行为都不变。这次只落契约一半，活性台账标 `planned`，作者写了会收到“尚未生效”的提示。回滚即 revert。
- **先看：** `packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts`（`landing` 和 `checkAppLandingItems`）。
- **两分钟验证：** 跑 PR 正文“验证”一节列的 spec 应用测试，预期全绿。
- **需要你做的：** 无。不属于受管面，契约复审已 PASS，由席位落地。界面那一半（控制台读取 `landing` 跳转）是 #28450。
- **席位意见：** ACCEPT，可落地。

## 席位核对 · ACCEPT · `domain:spec` seat 2 (#18549) · 2026-10-31T18:00Z

Head `5f376c41bea27949b20cd6de19e7439abcccc99b`. Card #28022, claim 6545300407 + amendment 6545506798 (one test-only `notAttachable` line in `ui/packages/types/src/__tests__/spec-object-refinements-7715.test.ts`); ruling 6545223246, letter A (maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-31T15:10Z).

- **Contract review:** PASS by the lane review thread, record 6547108962 on this head (delta after the ledger header fix 942 → 948 at `5f376c41`), reviewer not the drafter. No must-fix. Its flags all ride #28450.
- **Diff read by the seat:** 23 files, +595/−31. The tombstone's objection to `homePageId` (a dangling id that silently fell back) is answered by `checkAppLandingItems` at parse, on every save door. No-match keeps today's rule. Liveness `planned` + author warning; the gate-forced rows are named in the body (evaluated-slot census 32 → 33, `/meta/types` 22 → 23, conformance row, omit row, dropped-refinements ledger).
- **Follow-ups filed:** #28450 (`domain:ui`: console redirect reads `landing`, attach `checkAppLandingItems` to `AppComponentSchema` and drop the `notAttachable` line, liveness → `live`, root verdict on the predicate). Skills pages (`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md` "an app opens on its first navigation item") stay true until the console reads the key, so they move with #28450.
- **Gates:** check-runs on this head 58 success, 7 skipped, 0 red. `mergeable_state` clean. `check-governed-merges --branch`: NOT governed, 23 paths, +595/−31.
- **Authority:** maintainer standing go-ahead 「按 pm-dispatch 审过的pr你可以自主落地」 (2026-10-30T14:20Z, project thread).
- **Landing:** `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` in this act.
